Messages.Body:
Does Vidal (or Mata Hari) get the damage if the flipcoin comes up
tail?

My thoughts were that he wouldnt get the damage because he only met
the requirements to play the card, but is no Malkavian Antitribu. But
I could stand corrected.

Walk through Arcadia
Type: Action Modifier
Requires: Malkavian antitribu
Cost: 1 blood
Flip a coin. If it comes up heads, this action is unblockable. If it
comes up tails, the Malkavian antitribu takes one damage. This damage
is not preventable.

Vidal Jarbeaux
Clan: Toreador (group 5)
Capacity: 8
Disciplines: PRE aus cel obf pot
Camarilla: Vidal can meet the clan, sect, or non-infernal vampire
trait (e.g., anarch) requirement to play any card. He can meet a given
requirement only once each game. +1 bleed.

floppyzedolfin <floppyz...@gmail.com> wrote:
>On Oct 13, 11:41�am, eRol <der.e...@googlemail.com> wrote:

>

>Yes. They fake the requirement until the action modified is resolved.
>There's a ruling about Raking Talons played by Mata Hari (she gets agg
>hand strikes for the whole combat) that I can't find that shows it
>works this way.

Not quite that way.

When you fake a requirement ("play X as if..."), that specific card sees
you as that requirement for:

- playing the card
- resolving the card
- a lingering effect that does NOT depend on the card being in play.

It doesn't see you as being that requirement for effects that depend on
the card going in play. ("The X with this card..." and similar.)

http://www.thelasombra.com/rules/RTR7-7-7.txt

And note that you don't actually gain the faked requirement for the
purpose of other cards. You don't actually have that discipline. You
haven't actually changed clans. Other effects/cards won't see you with
the faked requirement.
